description: A dataset of annual surface water distribution in the growing season on the Mongolia Plateau from 2013 to 2022 2013–2022年蒙古高原逐年生长季地表水分布数据集 is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors LI Kai, WANG Juanle (中国矿业大学（北京），地球科学与测绘工程学院). Mongolia Plateau is located in arid and semi-arid areas, and hydrology and water resources are important constraints for the development of its resources and environment. Coverage: national (MN); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 92446373 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
